Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning mosquito abatement in storm water control retention ponds.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to mosquito abatement in storm water controlretention ponds; and adding a new section to chapter 90.03 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.03 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A county, city, town, water-sewer district, or flood control zonedistrict constructing, improving, operating, or maintaining storm watercontrol facilities under chapter 35.67, 35.92, 36.89, 36.94, 57.08, or86.15 RCW that include storm water retention ponds, also known as wetponds, wet retention ponds, or wet extended detention ponds, as part ofa storm water control facility for which the primary function of thepond is to detain storm water must: (1)(a) Design storm water retention ponds to inhibit mosquitobreeding; (b) Provide for maintenance and control of vegetation growth instorm water retention ponds to inhibit mosquito breeding; and (c) Consult with the local mosquito control district in thedevelopment of construction plans that include storm water retentionponds; and p. 1 SSB 5324 (2) Use integrated pest management, as defined under chapter 17.15RCW, for mosquito control or abatement in storm water retention ponds.
